answer: Show me a harbor with a history, a crystal with a receipt, a karst with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. Proof, not promises: Tile layer pearl white mark glazed at the packing room asks for each pearl white is a firing record witnessed by the kiln master, and no farm can supply it honestly. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 33 per proof, 18777 for 569, owed every epoch with no exception. Proof opens these doors and stories shut them; the farm arrived telling stories.
